relationship: One proposed meeting instant has different local clock and date representations, and it works only if its full duration fits every participant's availability.

learnerLoop.action: Place or calculate an organiser start time, send the proposal and inspect each local calendar.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The single meeting is converted into participant local times and dates.
learnerLoop.evidence: Linked calendars, fixed UTC offsets and availability checks show whether everyone can attend.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Shift the organiser time or justify the conflict or valid overlap.

invariants: All displayed local times refer to the same meeting instant.
A valid meeting must fit every attendee's entire duration, including date changes.
safeAdaptations: Vary fixed offsets, availability windows and meeting durations.
Adjust calculation support while retaining simultaneous local-calendar evidence.
nonGoals: Geographic time-zone lookup or daylight-saving rule modelling.
